title: Boil-water notice confirmation
purpose: make sure the person knows about the boil-water notice, understands what to do, and has safe water
questions: Have you heard that tap water in your area must be boiled or replaced with bottled water right now?
Do you have a way to boil water or enough bottled water for today?
Have you had stomach pain, vomiting or diarrhoea in the last day?
Is there anything you need: bottled water delivered, help boiling water, or someone to come by?
confusion_probe: If the person seems confused or disoriented, gently ask once: Can you tell me what day it is today?
red_flags: vomiting or diarrhoea with signs of dehydration
no safe water and no way to boil water
advice: Bring tap water to a rolling boil for one full minute before drinking, cooking, brushing teeth or making ice.
Bottled water is safe. Boiled water can be cooled and stored in a clean covered container.
Throw away ice made from tap water since the notice began.
red_flag_instruction: If the person is vomiting or has diarrhoea and cannot keep fluids down, tell them calmly to contact their doctor or call {{emergency_number}} if they feel faint, and that you are alerting their emergency contact.
voicemail_message: This is an automated call from {{org}}. A boil-water notice is in effect for your area. Boil tap water for one minute before drinking or use bottled water. We will try again shortly.

escalation_reason_templates.red: reported illness or no safe water during our boil-water call: {{reasons}}
escalation_reason_templates.unreachable: could not be reached by phone after {{attempts}} attempts about the boil-water notice
escalation_reason_templates.unverified: answered but we could not confirm they understood the notice
